# thalassa_iam_resource_access_bindings (Data Source)

List principals with IAM access to a resource identity in Thalassa Cloud. Requires projects to be enabled for the organisation (currently private beta).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_identity` (String) Identity of the resource to list access bindings for
- `resource_types` (List of String) Resource types to include in the access binding query

### Optional

- `binding_types` (List of String) Optional binding type filter
- `organisation_id` (String) Organisation for the query. If not provided, the organisation of the (Terraform) provider will be used.
- `permissions` (List of String) Optional permission filter (create, read, update, delete, list, *)

### Read-Only

- `bindings` (List of Object) Access bindings for the resource (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bindings))
- `id` (String) Data source identity (resource_identity)

<a id="nestedatt--bindings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bindings`

Read-Only:

- `binding_identity` (String)
- `binding_type` (String)
- `expires_at` (String)
- `permissions` (List of String)
- `policy_identity` (String)
- `policy_name` (String)
- `principal_display_name` (String)
- `principal_identity` (String)
- `principal_type` (String)
- `resource_type` (String)
